paragraphs: Rav Nachman son of Rav Ika.
Mentioned in Makkot 21, but Hyman says it should read R' Chanina son of Rav Ika.[^1]

notes.text: Makkot כא, gives 21 without an amud. Nachman to Chanina remains Hyman’s emendation, not a newly verified correction. Both supplied father-name occurrences are איקא, Ika; catalog איקאי, Ikai, remains a separate layer. The heading’s two Rav titles and the target father’s Rav are full, but Chanina’s own title is abbreviated and remains R'.
